name: Cold Case: Mystery Under Ice
source:
Eight researchers ventured into the snow. When one turns up dead, detective Jules Belefont must separate truth from lies – and uncover what really haunts the ice.

[From [url=https://mechanekodev.itch.io/cold-case-mystery-under-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
八名研究人员冒险进入雪地。当一个人被发现死亡时，侦探朱尔斯·贝尔方特必须区分真相和谎言，并找出真正困扰冰面的东西。

[来自[url=https://mechanekodev.itch.io/cold-case-mystery-under-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
